definitions.explanation: Difficulty or suffering endured through life's challenges.
The effort put into achieving something.

examples.japanese: {苦労|くろう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：02638_seikou⟧。
お{苦労|くろう}⟦さま→様：01549_sama⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for your hard work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦労|くろう}。

examples.english: I'm sorry to cause you trouble.

examples.english: My years of hard work were rewarded, and I was finally able to open my own shop.

notes:
{苦労|くろう} expresses hardship and effort.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {苦労|くろう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {苦労|くろう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have difficulty, to struggle)
- {苦労|くろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to cause trouble for someone)
- {苦労|くろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧ (hardships never end)
- {苦労|くろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報|むく}われる→報いる：12088_mukuiru⟧ (efforts are rewarded)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{苦労|くろう}⟦さま→様：01549_sama⟧(⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧) (thank you for your effort)
- {苦労|くろう}⟦{人|にん}→人：00476_hito⟧/{苦労|くろう}⟦{性|しょう}→性：noentry⟧ (someone who has known hardship)
- {苦労|くろう}⟦{話|ばなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ (tales of hardship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {苦労|くろう}: hardship (often life difficulties)
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: effort (more positive, self-motivated)
- ⟦{苦|く}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer (verb)
